explain_en: In Korea, some people ask your age when you first meet, because age affects speech style and how you address each other. To ask directly, 몇 살이에요? is common.

Our dog is three years old.
The kid next door is five years old.

usage: 스무 = 스물 before a counter: 스무 살, 스무 개.

explain_en: From 21 on it is 스물 again: 스물한 살, 스물두 명. “스무한 살” is wrong. 스무 is only for exactly twenty.

dis.h: native twenty; before counters like age

p.n: Age uses the native number, so 이십 sounds wrong here.

usage: 스물 = twenty (counting). Before a counter it becomes 스무: 스무 살.
explain: '스물'은 세는 말 앞에서 '스무'로 바뀌어요: 스무 살, 스무 개, 스무 명. 스물하나부터는 뒤의 하나·둘만 바뀌어요(스물한 살, 스물두 개).
